# Playbook: owners-dates
Use when: set owners, estimates or due dates; work a queue

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

## You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| projectId | the user | STOP. Say: "Which LPM project? (id or name)" |
| queue | "unassigned", "unestimated" or "overdue" when the user named that queue ("sem responsável", "sem estimativa", "atrasadas") | "none" |
| issueIds | the activity ids the user named | "none" |
| person | the owner's name or email as the user wrote it | "none" (no owner change) |
| estimate | hours as a number ("8h" → 8) | "none" |
| dueDate | the date as YYYY-MM-DD ("31/10" → "<this year>-10-31") | "none" |
| day | today's date as yyyymmdd | — |

## Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing more was changed."
1. CALL `get_mcp_connection_info` {} [A]
   IF <input:person>, <input:estimate> and <input:dueDate> are all "none" → STOP. Say: "Which owner, estimate or due date should I set?"
   IF result.credential == "oauth" and <input:person> != "none" → STOP. Say: "Assigning owners needs an LPM API key: connectors cannot list the eligible members."
   IF result.credential == "oauth" and <input:queue> != "none" → STOP. Say: "The unassigned, unestimated and overdue queues need an LPM API key. Name the activities instead."
   SAVE: targets = <input:issueIds> (empty if "none"); rows = empty; uid = "none"; owner = "none"; queueCount = "n/a"
   IF <input:queue> == "none" → go to step 5.
   IF <input:queue> == "unestimated" → go to step 3.
   IF <input:queue> == "overdue" → go to step 4.
2. CALL `list_unassigned_project_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: targets = the id of the first 25 items; queueCount = result.count; go to step 5.
3. CALL `list_unestimated_project_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   SAVE: targets = the id of the first 25 items; queueCount = result.count; go to step 5.
4. CALL `list_overdue_project_issues` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","limitCount":100} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "The overdue queue is denied (<error text>): it needs a project governance role. Name the activities, or ask for the daily sync."
   SAVE: targets = the id of the first 25 items; queueCount = result.count
5. IF <input:person> == "none" → go to step 7.
6. CALL `list_project_assignable_members` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>"} [A]
   SAVE: matches = the items whose displayName or email contains <input:person>, ignoring case
   IF <saved:matches> is empty or has 2 or more items → STOP. Say: "Which person: <each match as "<displayName> (<email>)">?"
   Show only displayName and email: never hourlyRate, currency or directoryOrigins. Never pick one yourself; never use a workspace or team member id.
   SAVE: uid = the uid of the one match; owner = its displayName (else its email)
7. FOR EACH target IN <saved:targets> (none → go to step 8):
   CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<each:id>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<each:id> could not be read: <error text>. Nothing was changed."
   SAVE: rows = <saved:rows> plus "<each:id> '<result.title>'" and, for each field you set, "owner <result.assigneeId or none> → <saved:owner>", "estimate <result.estimate or none> → <input:estimate>", "due <result.dueDate or none> → <input:dueDate>"
8. IF <saved:rows> is empty → STOP. Say: "Which activities? Name their ids, or a queue: unassigned, unestimated or overdue."
   SAVE: n = 1 + the number of batch keys you already sent for <input:projectId> in this conversation; key = "plan-<input:projectId>-<input:day>-<saved:n>"
   SAVE: issueId = per entry of <saved:targets>, its id (one operations item per target)
9. ASK: "Apply this plan? <each line of <saved:rows>> (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP. Say: "Nothing was changed."
   This one "yes" covers owner, estimate and due date together.
10. CALL `batch_issue_operations` {"idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>","stopOnError":false,"operations":[{"tool":"update_issue","arguments":{"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:issueId>","assigneeId":"<saved:uid>","estimate":"<input:estimate>","dueDate":"<input:dueDate>"}}]} [A] (one operations item per target; keep only the fields you set; estimate as a number, without quotes; never null)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "batch_issue_operations failed: <error text>. Run me again: I re-read every activity before writing."
   SAVE: failed = for each item with status "failed" or "skipped": the issueId of its operation and its error message; firstOk = the issueId of the first item with status "succeeded"
   IF <saved:firstOk> is empty → go to step 11.
   VERIFY: CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<saved:firstOk>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or a field you set does not equal the plan → STOP. Say: "<saved:firstOk> does not show the new values: <error text or its values>."
11. FOR EACH target IN <saved:targets> (none → go to step 12):
   CALL `get_issue` {"projectId":"<input:projectId>","issueId":"<each:id>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error and <each:id> is not in <saved:failed> → STOP. Say: "<each:id> could not be read back: <error text>."
   IF the call succeeds, <each:id> is not in <saved:failed>, and a field you set does not equal the plan → STOP. Say: "<each:id> does not show the new values."
   A failed id that get_issue cannot find ("Issue not found") was deleted after the queue read: never retry or recreate it.
12. SAVE: changed = the rows of <saved:rows> whose id is not in <saved:failed>; pending = one "<issueId> — <error>" line per entry of <saved:failed>

## Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: project <input:projectId>, <queue <input:queue> (<saved:queueCount> in queue) | the named activities>
Done: <each line of <saved:changed> | nothing changed>
Evidence: batch <saved:key>: planned <entries of <saved:targets>>, updated <entries of <saved:changed>>, failed <entries of <saved:failed>>; read back with get_issue | none
Pending: <none | <saved:pending> — the user decides (I never recreate a deleted activity)>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | resend only the failed ids (I build a new key) | confirm the dates with <saved:owner> | none>
```
Pending is never "none" while <saved:failed> has an entry. Never claim a value changed unless a get_issue above read it.
